To: All Staff, Hawthorne Gas & Electric, Riverbend Office
From: Curtis Delgado, Facilities Manager
Date: July 14
Re: Building Energy Conservation Measures — August Trial

As an energy provider, we are often asked whether we follow the conservation advice we give customers. This August, the Riverbend office will pilot a set of internal conservation measures, and the results will be shared publicly in our autumn sustainability report.

The following changes will be in place from August 3 to August 31. Cooling setpoints will rise from 22 to 24 degrees Celsius in open work areas; conference rooms will remain at 22 degrees when booked. Lighting in corridors and storage areas will switch to occupancy sensors, which facilities crews will install during the last week of July, outside business hours. Window blinds on the south side of the building should be lowered by 11:00 A.M. each day — reminders will appear on the building's digital displays. Finally, the cafeteria will replace its two oldest refrigerated display cases, which together consume more electricity than all the office's printers combined.

We anticipate a reduction of roughly twelve percent in the building's August electricity use compared with last August. Staff who have concerns about workspace comfort — particularly those near the south windows — should contact the facilities help desk, and desk fans will be provided on request.

If the trial meets its target, the measures will be made permanent here and extended to our Lakeshore and Dunmore offices next year.

To test products before selling them to customers

To: All Loan Officers and Branch Managers, Pellworth Community Bank
From: Susannah Greer, Director of Community Lending

Re: Launch of the Storefront Revival Loan Program

On April 14, Pellworth Community Bank will launch the Storefront Revival Loan, a new product supporting small businesses that renovate street-level commercial spaces in the Old Mill and Tannery Row districts. The program is funded in part by a development grant from the city, which allows us to offer rates 1.5 percentage points below our standard commercial renovation loans.

Key terms: loans range from $20,000 to $150,000, with repayment periods up to ten years. Eligible expenses include facade restoration, accessibility improvements, signage, and interior renovations of customer-facing areas. Back-office improvements and inventory purchases are not eligible under the grant's terms, so applications mixing eligible and ineligible costs must itemize them separately.

Applicants must hold a current business license, have operated for at least one year, and provide a contractor's estimate with their application. Because grant funds are capped, the program will accept applications only until allocated funds are exhausted — based on inquiry volume so far, we project this could occur within four months.

A briefing for loan officers will be held on April 2 at the main office, repeated by videoconference on April 4. Marketing materials, including window posters for participating branches, will arrive by April 9. Direct program questions to my office; media inquiries must go to corporate communications.

questions.question: What does Ms. Walsh plan to do about the swim club's practice?

Move it to another facility across town
Hold it in the leisure pool in the evening
Shorten it to thirty minutes

The projector should be thrown away immediately.
The speaker prefers printed handouts.

Additional registration staff

Move the truck to the promenade immediately

passage:

questions.question: What problem does Ms. Caldwell report?
options: A rehearsal space was double-booked.
Several cast members are ill.
The theater's lights are not working.
A ballet class was canceled.
questions.explanation: 첫 메시지에서 댄스 스튜디오 측이 목요일에 이중 예약을 받아서 발레 수업이 오후 8시까지 그 공간을 쓰게 되었다고 알립니다. 즉 리허설 장소의 이중 예약이 문제입니다.

The theater would be unsuitable on Friday because of lighting work.
The crew should finish hanging lights before dark.

questions.question: What is indicated about the church hall?

questions.question: What does Mr. Fuentes ask Ms. Caldwell to do?

passage:

Collect altered costumes from the tailor

questions.question: Why does Mr. Reed contact Ms. Doyle?

questions.question: What will Sofia most likely do at around 3:30 P.M.?

Head directly from the school board meeting to city hall
Begin filming the harbor cleanup
Meet the graphics team about a chart

questions.question: At 2:24 P.M., what does Mr. Reed most likely mean when he writes, "You drive a hard bargain"?
options: He thinks the time limit is demanding but he will accept it.
He wants to renegotiate his salary.
He believes the budget vote will fail.
He refuses to shorten his report.

questions.question: According to Ms. Doyle, what will happen if the vote runs late?

The station will air a live report from outside the council chamber.

The show will be extended by two minutes.

The suite requires a complete, thorough cleaning today.
The suite is being used to store equipment.
The carpets and drapes have been sent out for repair.

questions.question: What will Ms. Reyes do at 11:45 A.M.?

Personally inspect the suite
Repair the carpet machine
Train the eighth-floor staff

passage:
Nadia Osman (1:40 P.M.): Team, we're 60 king sheet sets short for tonight's turnover. The laundry chute jam this morning put everything behind.

Airline crew members begin arriving at 4:30.
They were skipped during yesterday's cleaning.
A health inspection is scheduled there.

The laundry chute must be replaced.

It has unsold copies because one of its events was canceled.
It ordered too few copies of the book.
It is hosting the author next week.

questions.question: At 12:16 P.M., what does Ms. Werner most likely mean when she writes, "Small price"?

The signing tickets should cost less.

questions.question: What will customers who cannot buy a book at the event receive?

Spend half an hour resting in the office

Inspect the reserved seating area

The faucets should be held for a quality inspection.
The shipment should be returned to Hargrove Imports.
The backorders should be canceled.

Search nearby bays and the returns cage for the tile pallet

Observer details must be filed with the city 24 hours before the flight.

The production office closes early on Fridays.

questions.question: At 4:18 P.M., what does Mr. Mehta most likely mean when he writes, "Friday is cutting it fine"?

questions.question: Why will ScoreTech still be booked for Friday?
